question_text:
114. Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List

Given the root of a binary tree, flatten the tree into a "linked list" in-place. The "linked list" should use the TreeNode class where the right child pointer points to the next node in the list and the left child pointer is always null. The list should be in the same order as a pre-order traversal.
input_format: A serialized level-order traversal array of a binary tree.
output_format: A serialized level-order traversal array of the flattened tree.
explanation: A post-order approach (Right, Left, Root) can flatten the tree in place. Keep track of the previously visited node in this traversal. For each node, set its right to the previous node, its left to null, and then update the previous node to be the current node.
